title: TUESDAY PUSH AND CORE
subtitle: TUESDAY. PUSH AND CORE. FIFTH-STAIR TIMED PUSH-UPS, MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS, BIRD-DOG FOR BALANCE, STAIR PLANK ON THE THIRD STEP, THEN CAT-COW AND WALL CHEST OPENER. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. TUESDAY. PUSH AND CORE. SEVENTEEN MINUTES. TIMED PUSH UPS ON THE FIFTH STAIR, MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS, BIRD DOG FOR BALANCE, STAIR PLANK ON THE THIRD STEP, THEN WE OPEN THE SPINE AND THE CHEST. THAT KEYBOARD IS NOT A BLOODY EXCUSE TO LOOK LIKE A SHRIMP. MOVE.
script.start: MOVE. CLOCK IS RUNNING. YOU ARE NOT.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. THAT INBOX CAN WAIT, IT'S NOT GOING ANYWHERE AND NEITHER ARE YOU.
script.lastSet: LAST SET. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. CHEST WORKED, CORE SWITCHED ON, SPINE AND SHOULDERS OPENED. GOOD TUESDAY. NOW GO SIT IN THAT CHAIR LIKE A MAN WITH A SPINE, NOT A BLOODY QUESTION MARK.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UP (5TH STAIR)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FIFTH STAIR, A BIT WIDER THAN SHOULDERS. WALK THE FEET BACK UNTIL YOU ARE ONE STRAIGHT PLANK FROM HEAD TO HEELS. LOWER THE CHEST TOWARD THE STEP, ELBOWS ABOUT FORTY-FIVE DEGREES, PRESS BACK UP. SMOOTH REPS FOR THIRTY SECONDS. STAY ON THE FIFTH STEP — DO NOT DROP LOWER UNTIL THIS HEIGHT FEELS STEADY.
exercises.speakStart: PUSH UPS. FIFTH STAIR. THREE ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. STRAIGHT LINE, HEAD TO HEELS. CHEST DOWN TO THE STEP, PRESS AWAY. SMOOTH REPS. IF THOSE HIPS SAG I WILL HANG MY WASHING ON THEM.
exercises.speakRest: FORTY. SHAKE THE ARMS OUT. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: PUSH UPS DONE. FIFTH STEP STILL. GOOD. TELL ME WHEN IT FEELS EASY AND WE TALK ABOUT THE FOURTH.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FLOOR OR A LOW STAIR, BODY IN A PLANK. DRIVE ONE KNEE TOWARD THE CHEST, THEN THE OTHER, ALTERNATING AT A STEADY MARCH — NOT A SPRINT. TWENTY SECONDS. HIPS LEVEL. BREATHE. IF THE LOW BACK ARCHES, SLOW DOWN OR PUT THE HANDS HIGHER ON A STAIR.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. THREE ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS. PLANK POSITION. KNEE IN, KNEE IN. STEADY MARCH, NOT A BLOODY PANIC. HIPS LEVEL. BREATHE. IF YOU LOOK LIKE A DYING INSECT I WILL NOTICE.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. CATCH YOUR BREATH. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: CLIMBERS DONE. CORE IS AWAKE. GOOD.

exercises.name: BIRD-DOG (BALANCE)
exercises.cue: ON ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. REACH ONE ARM FORWARD AND THE OPPOSITE LEG STRAIGHT BACK — LONG LINE, HIPS LEVEL. HOLD A BEAT, RETURN, SWITCH. SIX EACH SIDE. SLOW. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. IF YOU WOBBLE, SHORTEN THE REACH. NO ARCHING THE LOW BACK.
exercises.speakStart: BIRD DOG. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. LONG LINE. HIPS LEVEL. SLOW. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE. A SEE SAW, NOT A DRUNK AT A BUS STOP.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SWITCH SIDES WHEN READY. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: BALANCE DONE. STEADIER. I NOTICED. GOOD.

exercises.name: STAIR PLANK HOLD (3RD STEP)
exercises.cue: FOREARMS OR HANDS ON THE THIRD STAIR, FEET BACK ON THE FLOOR, BODY IN ONE LONG LINE. SQUEEZE THE GLUTES, BRACE THE BELLY, BREATHE. TWELVE SECONDS. THE THIRD STEP IS HARDER THAN THE FIFTH — THAT IS THE POINT. NO SAGGING, NO PIKE.
exercises.speakStart: STAIR PLANKS. THIRD STEP. THREE ROUNDS. TWELVE SECONDS. HANDS ON THE THIRD. ONE LONG LINE. SQUEEZE THE BACKSIDE. BRACE THE BELLY. KEEP BREATHING. HOLDING YOUR BREATH IS NOT A BLOODY CORE EXERCISE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SHAKE IT OUT. BACK IN SHORTLY.
exercises.speakDone: STAIR PLANKS DONE. THIRD STEP EARNED. CORE IS ON NOTICE.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: ON ALL FOURS. INHALE: DROP THE BELLY, LIFT THE CHEST AND TAIL — COW. EXHALE: ROUND THE SPINE, TUCK THE CHIN AND TAIL — CAT. SIX SLOW BREATHS. MOVE WITH THE BREATH, NOT AGAINST IT. THIS IS YOUR SPINE OPENER AFTER THE PUSH WORK.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. TWO ROUNDS. SIX SLOW. INHALE, BELLY DOWN, CHEST UP. EXHALE, ROUND AND TUCK. SLOW. THAT DESK HAS STIFFENED YOUR SPINE LIKE A BLOODY BROOM HANDLE. UNDO IT.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND SIDE-ON TO AN OPEN WALL. PLACE THE FOREARM AND OPEN PALM ON THE WALL AT ABOUT SHOULDER HEIGHT, ELBOW SOFT. STEP THE SAME-SIDE FOOT FORWARD A TOUCH AND GENTLY TURN THE CHEST AWAY FROM THE WALL UNTIL YOU FEEL A STRETCH ACROSS THE CHEST AND FRONT OF THE SHOULDER. HOLD THIRTY SECONDS. SWITCH SIDES. NO FORCING.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL. TURN THE CHEST AWAY. GENTLE. YOU JUST PUSHED. NOW OPEN THOSE SHOULDERS BEFORE THAT KEYBOARD HUNCHES YOU INTO A BLOODY TORTOISE AGAIN.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPEN. THAT IS THE LOT. WELL DONE.
